title: Swe entry systemdesign url shortener
question: How would you design a basic URL shortener, the kind that takes a long URL and gives you back a short one that redirects to it?
idealAnswer:
Core data model: a table mapping a short code to the original long URL, plus basics like created_at and maybe an expiry or owner

Explains how the short code is generated, e.g. a counter or random string encoded in base62, and checks for collisions before saving

Describes the redirect flow: GET /{code} looks up the long URL and returns an HTTP redirect (3xx) to it

Considers read-heavy traffic pattern (many more redirects than creations) and mentions caching popular short codes to avoid hitting the database on every redirect

Mentions at least one real-world concern beyond the happy path: handling duplicate submissions of the same long URL, invalid/malicious URLs, or short code collisions
